title: The M4 iPad Air is almost as cheap as it was before Apple raised prices
content:
Macworld

Save $100 on the 11-inch iPad Air

View Deal

Even after Apple raised prices in June, the M4 iPad Air is still the best option for tablet buyers looking for the best performance, size, and value in the iPad lineup. And for the first time, it’s nearly as cheap as it was before: Amazon is selling the 128GB M4 iPad Air in all colors for $100 off, bringing the price down to $649.

The iPad Air is a fantastic tablet, with an 11-inch Liquid Retina display, speedy M4 processor, 12MP front and rear cameras, and a Touch ID-equipped power button. This model was just released in March, but it looks the same as it has since its 2020 redesign. Still, if you haven’t bought an iPad in a few years, this is a great time to grab one.

We’re not fans of Apple’s new iPad pricing, but we still think the 11-inch M4 iPad Air is the smartest tablet for just about anyone. So if you want one, go save $100 and grab one before the price jumps back up.
